title: Learning to Defer under Expert Drift
abstract: arXiv:2611.26440v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The learning to defer (L2D) framework enables safety in machine learning and AI systems by allocating difficult or critical decisions to a human expert. However, most prior work on L2D assumes fixed expert reliability, overlooking temporal fluctuations in human performance due to factors such as fatigue and cognitive biases. Humans commonly exhibit such substantial, systematic performance shifts across a wide range of domains, from high-stakes settings such as radiology, aviation, and judicial decision-making, to everyday tasks such as crowdsourced image annotation. We propose Expert-Drift-Adapted Learning-to-Defer (EDA-L2D), a novel expert-aware L2D framework that explicitly models these temporal shifts by conditioning the deferral head on recent histories of expert outcomes via a sequence model. translated_title: 专家漂移下的学习延迟决策
translated_abstract: 学习延迟决策框架通过将困难或关键决策分配给人类专家，从而保障机器学习和AI系统的安全性。然而，大多数先前的L2D研究都假设专家的可靠性是固定的，忽略了由于疲劳和认知偏差等因素导致的人类表现的时间波动。人类在从放射学、航空和司法决策等高风险场景，到众包图像标注等日常任务的广泛领域中，普遍表现出这种显著且系统性的性能变化。我们提出了专家漂移自适应学习延迟决策，这是一种新颖的专家感知L2D框架，通过序列模型将延迟决策头条件化于专家近期结果的历史记录，从而显式建模这些时间漂移。这种历史感知方法能够实现自适应的延迟策略，预测可靠性的波动并更好地在各决策主体之间分配决策。
tldr: 提出EDA-L2D框架，利用序列模型对专家近期决策结果历史进行建模，显式捕捉因疲劳、认知偏差等因素导致的专家可靠性时间漂移，实现自适应的延迟决策策略。
en_tdlr: Proposes EDA-L2D, a novel expert-aware learning-to-defer framework that explicitly models temporal fluctuations in expert reliability by conditioning the deferral head on recent expert outcome histories via a sequence model, enabling adaptive deferral policies.
